steps: Call exports_sources_get. Write every source name with its columns to .exports/sources.json.
For the seller performance table, the FBA inventory table and the orders table: export one day each (yesterday), record max(date) and the Jerusalem clock time of the call.
Write state/preflight.md in the state_file format: line 1 header dated today; ## Data = table | max_date | lag_days | checked_at.
Append to ops/OPERATING-NOTES.md the exact table and column names the other jobs must use.
Create nothing. Change nothing outside the writes list.
done_when: state/preflight.md contains a max_date row for the seller performance table

steps: If state/preflight.md shows lag_days > 2 for the seller performance table, write the state file saying so and stop.

Export the latest seller performance row for marketplace CA: AHR, ODR, late shipment, cancellation, valid tracking, on-time delivery, the policy-violation counts, each with Amazon's own target column.
Verdict per metric: AHR < 200 or any violation count > 0 => P0; any metric worse than its target => P1; else OK.
Write state/account-health.md: header dated today; ## Data = metric | value | target | verdict; ## Findings; ## Proposals written (none); ## Requests sent (none); ## Blocked.
Append one observation line per P0 or P1 to departments/account-health/memory/<today>.md with source: the export id.
If state/preflight.md shows lag_days > 2 for the inventory or orders table, write the state file saying so and stop.
Export FBA inventory by SKU for CA (available, inbound, reserved) and units ordered by SKU for the last 28 days.
cover_days = available / (units_28d / 28) per SKU. No smoothing, no forecast.
Flag every SKU with cover_days below 14. Rank by units per day descending.
Write state/supply-chain.md: header dated today; ## Data = sku | available | inbound | units_per_day | cover_days | flag; the other four sections.
Write no proposal today: T0, and no supplier file exists to price a PO. Append observations for every flagged SKU.
Read every state file. Any not dated today is listed first in the brief as 'did not run', by name.

Write briefs/<today>-decisions.md: header line, then at most 5 items ranked P0 first, each one line: verb, subject, number, deadline, 'if ignored', and the state-file line it cites. An empty list is a correct answer and must say why it is empty.
Write state/ceo.md: ## Data = department | ran | dated | p0 | p1.
Do not call monday. The projection script mirrors the brief when the board exists.
